evidence.source: REM-56 gate found a real fail-OPEN boundary in panelCoverageManifest.js: a reminder path with no explicit rule fell through to the final `*` catch-all and was classified `summary`, so any reminder root/key a future app version adds (reminderQueueV2, remindersV2, notifications.*.reminderBody, days.*.reminderCompletion) would have been copied raw into snapshot.data; worse, the coverage list published the RAW PATH, and because a user names their own reminders, a line like `reminderQueueV2.Anneme ilac ver.body` carried the private title itself into observer-snapshot.json; the declared `unmappedPaths` list was dead code and never populated. The reminder namespace is now fail-closed (`unmapped` + withheld) and that check runs BEFORE the fullDetail allowlist, so a reminder field landing inside an allowed root such as `notifications` can never become `full`; unmapped audit entries are masked to identifier-shaped tokens. MANIFEST.reminderCoverage freezes 12 field classes with one mode plus rationale, and new pure classifyPath() / reminderCoverageReport() APIs report declaration-vs-resolution parity. Wire contract unbroken: schemaVersion 1 and manifestVersion panel-coverage-v1 preserved, classification carries its own panel-reminder-coverage-v1 contractVersion written additively as reminderCoverageVersion. settings.prayer.remindersEnabled/reminderOffsetMinutes got explicit summary rules against over-capture; app runtime, panel runtime, Panel-v2 and protected paths untouched
